title: What is a .Dat file in windows?
content:
Sometimes you might have received an email containing an attachment with .Dat extension, and then you must have questioned yourself that “What is .Dat file”. Further you might have asked that how to excess this particular file. So, let’s have a look at solution to those frequent doubts.
The very first thing that .Dat file indicates is that it contains some random data and it is not designed to be used by some specific applications. It means unlike the case of some frequently used file, let’s say seeing an XLS file one can easily say that it should be opened by Microsoft Excel, but in case of .Dat file you yourself have to decide that with which program you must open that file. It can be different programs at different times.
content_hi:
कभी-कभी आपको एक ईमेल प्राप्त हो सकता है जिसमें डैट एक्सटेंशन होता है, और फिर आपने खुद से सवाल किया होगा कि "डैट फ़ाइल क्या है"। इसके अलावा आपने पूछा होगा कि इस विशेष फ़ाइल को कैसे अतिरिक्त करें। तो, आइए उन लगातार संदेहों के समाधान पर नज़र डालें।

पहली बात यह है कि डेटा फ़ाइल इंगित करती है कि इसमें कुछ यादृच्छिक डेटा शामिल है और इसे कुछ विशिष्ट अनुप्रयोगों द्वारा उपयोग करने के लिए डिज़ाइन नहीं किया गया है। इसका मतलब है कि कुछ बार उपयोग की जाने वाली फ़ाइल के मामले के विपरीत, मान लीजिए कि एक एक्सएलएस फाइल देखने से कोई आसानी से कह सकता है कि इसे माइक्रोसॉफ्ट एक्सेल द्वारा खोला जाना चाहिए, लेकिन डीएटी फाइल के मामले में आपको खुद को यह तय करना होगा कि आपको किस प्रोग्राम के साथ खोलना होगा फ़ाइल। यह अलग-अलग समय पर अलग-अलग कार्यक्रम हो सकता है।

ai_summary: .Dat files contain random data and are not tied to specific applications, requiring users to determine the appropriate program for opening them.
These files often appear as email attachments, and their extensions may change during email routing, necessitating manual adjustments.
To open a .Dat file, users can try using Notepad or the original application that created the file, or change its extension to the correct format.

sub_contents.sub_content:
The most appropriate way of opening a .Dat extension file is to utilize the same application which created it. In case of uncertainty one can try out with notepad. After opening the file with notepad one may recognize some part of the data, however most of the remaining part would be unrecognizable and most probably junk ejected by the source program.
These files are normally found in emails with attachments. However programs of these days do not produce any .Dat file and it is usually being used by programmers only.
To search “What is a dat file” initially you must inquire about the file from the sender that which application was used for its creation. If their response has a sense that it was just mere document or picture file with some other extensions, and they are not sure how it turned into a .Dat file, then it means file extension was changed during the email routing process.
Actually it may appear odd, but some email server programs change the extensions of attached to .Dat files automatically. Therefore if you were supposed to receive an image file, all you need to do is to change the extension of the file to JPG, PNG or GIP whichever you think would be more appropriate. A Microsoft word file should be changed to extension .Doc.
To change the file extension select Tools under File Options in windows explorer.
Then select the View tab and keep scrolling down until the option “Hide extensions for known file types” appears. Uncheck it to see the extension of all the files in that folder which you can change to something else.
All you need to do is right click over the file and change the extension which appears after the dot to any preferred format.
Finally, you must observe that change of icon of the file, representing the application which can open it. Like for an Excel sheet it should be an MS Excel icon.
Now what should you do if you are still struggling finding the right source program or the extension of the original file? Go for a right click over the file and keep on selecting different programs through Open With option. It means if an XLS file is changed to .Dat file and you try to open it with MS Excel then it will work.
The above case was true because the file was created using an Excel application and all the data in it is appropriate, only the file extension has changed.
One can even go on trying for Windows media player as it would execute it if it happen to be some video file, any MP3 file or maybe any other file of similar nature. So using any of the above methods can bring an answer to your doubt that “What is a dat file”
sub_contents.sub_content_hi:
डीएटी एक्सटेंशन फ़ाइल खोलने का सबसे उचित तरीका उसी एप्लिकेशन का उपयोग करना है जिसने इसे बनाया है। अनिश्चितता के मामले में कोई नोटपैड के साथ प्रयास कर सकता है। नोटपैड के साथ फ़ाइल खोलने के बाद डेटा के कुछ हिस्से को पहचान सकते हैं, हालांकि शेष भाग का अधिकांश हिस्सा पहचाना जा सकता है और संभवतः स्रोत कार्यक्रम द्वारा निकाला जाने वाला जंक होगा।

ये फ़ाइलें आम तौर पर संलग्नक वाले ईमेल में पाई जाती हैं। हालांकि इन दिनों के कार्यक्रम किसी भी डेटा फ़ाइल का उत्पादन नहीं करते हैं और आमतौर पर प्रोग्रामर द्वारा इसका उपयोग किया जा रहा है।

शुरुआत में "डेटा फ़ाइल क्या है" खोजने के लिए आपको प्रेषक से फ़ाइल के बारे में पूछना चाहिए कि उसके निर्माण के लिए किस एप्लिकेशन का उपयोग किया गया था। अगर उनकी प्रतिक्रिया का एहसास है कि यह कुछ अन्य एक्सटेंशन के साथ सिर्फ दस्तावेज़ या चित्र फ़ाइल था, और वे निश्चित नहीं हैं कि यह कैसे एक फ़ाइल फ़ाइल में बदल गया है, तो इसका मतलब है कि ईमेल रूटिंग प्रक्रिया के दौरान फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन बदल दिया गया था।

दरअसल यह अजीब दिखाई दे सकता है, लेकिन कुछ ईमेल सर्वर प्रोग्राम स्वचालित रूप से .at फ़ाइलों से जुड़े एक्सटेंशन को बदलते हैं। इसलिए यदि आपको एक छवि फ़ाइल प्राप्त होनी थी, तो आपको बस इतना करना है कि फ़ाइल का विस्तार जेपीजी, पीएनजी या जीआईपी में बदलना है, जो भी आपको लगता है कि यह अधिक उपयुक्त होगा। एक माइक्रोसॉफ्ट शब्द फ़ाइल को विस्तार में बदला जाना चाहिए। डॉक।

फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन को बदलने के लिए विंडोज एक्सप्लोरर में फ़ाइल विकल्प के तहत टूल्स का चयन करें।

फिर व्यू टैब का चयन करें और "ज्ञात फ़ाइल प्रकारों के लिए एक्सटेंशन छुपाएं" विकल्प दिखाई देने तक स्क्रॉलिंग रखें। उस फ़ोल्डर में सभी फ़ाइलों का विस्तार देखने के लिए इसे अनचेक करें जिसे आप किसी और चीज़ में बदल सकते हैं।

आपको बस इतना करना है कि फ़ाइल पर राइट क्लिक करें और डॉट के बाद दिखाई देने वाले एक्सटेंशन को किसी भी पसंदीदा प्रारूप में बदलें।

अंत में, आपको उस फ़ाइल का आइकन बदलना चाहिए, जो एप्लिकेशन को प्रदर्शित कर सकता है जो इसे खोल सकता है। एक्सेल शीट की तरह यह एक एमएस एक्सेल आइकन होना चाहिए।

अब यदि आप अभी भी सही स्रोत प्रोग्राम या मूल फ़ाइल के विस्तार को ढूंढने में संघर्ष कर रहे हैं तो आपको क्या करना चाहिए? फ़ाइल पर राइट क्लिक के लिए जाएं और विकल्प के साथ ओपन के माध्यम से विभिन्न प्रोग्राम चुनने पर जाएं। इसका मतलब है कि यदि एक एक्सएलएस फ़ाइल को डीएटी फ़ाइल में बदल दिया गया है और आप इसे एमएस एक्सेल के साथ खोलने का प्रयास करते हैं तो यह काम करेगा।

उपर्युक्त मामला सच था क्योंकि फ़ाइल Excel अनुप्रयोग का उपयोग करके बनाई गई थी और इसमें सभी डेटा उचित है, केवल फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन बदल गया है।

कोई भी विंडोज मीडिया प्लेयर की कोशिश करने पर भी जा सकता है क्योंकि यह कुछ वीडियो फ़ाइल, किसी भी एमपी 3 फ़ाइल या शायद इसी तरह की प्रकृति की कोई अन्य फ़ाइल होने पर इसे निष्पादित करेगा। तो उपर्युक्त विधियों में से किसी एक का उपयोग करके आपके संदेह का उत्तर मिल सकता है कि "डेटा फ़ाइल क्या है"

related.title: Impact of Rising Fuel Prices on Indian Economy
related.title_hi: भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था पर बढ़ती ईंधन की कीमतों का प्रभाव
related.content:
Rising fuel prices have a significant impact on the Indian economy, affecting various sectors and the daily lives of citizens. As fuel prices increase, transportation costs rise, leading to higher prices for goods and services. This situation creates a ripple effect, influencing inflation rates and overall economic stability.

Moreover, higher fuel costs strain the budgets of both individuals and businesses, leading to decreased consumer spending and investment. Understanding these dynamics is crucial for grasping the broader economic implications of fuel price fluctuations in India.

related.title: Impact of Electric Vehicles on India's Economy
related.title_hi: भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था पर इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों का प्रभाव
related.content:
Electric vehicles (EVs) are rapidly transforming the transportation landscape in India, presenting both challenges and opportunities for the economy. As the country strives to reduce its dependence on fossil fuels and combat pollution, the adoption of electric vehicles is becoming a pivotal part of its economic strategy. This shift not only promises to create a greener environment but also offers significant economic benefits, from job creation to advancements in technology.

The shift towards electric mobility is expected to enhance India's energy security, create new markets, and foster innovation in various sectors. By investing in EV infrastructure and technologies, India aims to position itself as a global leader in the electric vehicle industry, contributing positively to the overall economic growth.

related.title: What is an annular solar eclipse?
related.content:
As the name suggests it is a solar eclipse. There are three major types of solar eclipses.

The total solar eclipse, partial solar eclipse, and the annular solar eclipse.  

The name “annular” has its origin from the Latin word “annulus”, "a ring". If the characteristic ring of fire is visible from even just one location, the whole eclipse is called an annular solar eclipse.

However, in most places and for most of the duration, an annular eclipse looks like a partial solar eclipse. At Box of Science, we are trying to reach out to people so that they may understand and observe this celestial event, as such events are very rare.

related.title: Fact Check: Is World Going To End On June 21 According To Mayan Calendar?
related.title_hi: तथ्य की जाँच करें: क्या मई 21 कैलेंडर के अनुसार विश्व का अंत हो सकता है?
related.content:
Fact check: A number of social media users have shared a conspiracy theory suggesting that the world will end on June 21, 2020, but they have proven false.

 

What does the theory suggest? 

According to various conspiracy theorists on social media, the initial reading of the Mayan calendar which suggested that the world will end in 2012 was wrong. It originally prophesied by calendar readers that the world will end on December 21, 2012, according to the Mayan calendar. The new theory suggests that we are 'technically' still in the year 2012 if the Julian calendar is followed. The theory also bases its claims on a previously falsified theory which suggested that eight years were lost during the transition from the Julian to the Gregorian calendar. 

 

Origin

Social media has witnessed a recent trend where a number of conspiracy theorists have been posting unverified theories on the internet which increase the paranoia in people's minds. As the COVID-19 outbreak became a global scare, a number of users started posting theories that suggest that 2020 will be the final year witnessed by humanity. Some wild theories also suggested that the events of the apocalypse are taking place in the world, but did not have any concrete evidence backing them. Similarly, the recent conspiracy theory doing the rounds on social media which suggests that the world will end on June 21, 2020, according to the Mayan calendar also does not hold any truth. 

 

The world was previously prophesied to end on December 21, 2012. Various conspiracy theorists used the Mayan calendar to push a theory that put a doomsday on Earth's experience. This latest conspiracy theory also uses the Mayan calendar theory which was officially shunned by NASA back in 2012. NASA officials had stated during a public conversation there was no science behind any claims of disaster and dramatic changes in 2012, also that there was no evidence that could back the theory. Since there was no evidence, NASA deemed the theory as a fictional assertion that could not change the facts. 

 

Google Trends Analysis

As witnessed earlier, the conspiracy theories which suggest dramatic and disastrous consequences often gain traction from people who wish to find the truth themselves. Similarly, a number of people took to Google and searched whether the recent conspiracy theory holds any truth to it. This resulted in a surge of search results surrounding topics like 'Alternate reading of Mayan calendar', 'Mayan calendar June 21, 2020', and various others.

 

source: https://www.republicworld.com/fact-check/viral/fact-check-is-the-world-going-to-end-on-june-21.html
